Mochi’s Colors & Shapes

A tiny book for a tiny reader 🐱

A big RED circle!

Round, round, round — like a bouncy ball.

A bright BLUE square!

Four straight sides, all the same.

A sunny YELLOW triangle!

Pointy at the top — wheee!

A twinkly GREEN star!

Reach up high and catch it.

Red, blue, yellow, green!

Mochi loves ALL the colors and shapes. The end ❤️
